# Open questions — pixelkit

What is not yet known, and what has since been answered.

## Open

### Should damage be a list of rectangles rather than one bounding rectangle?

`open` · `@pixelkit.question.damage-granularity/1`

WindowBuffer::damage is one bounding rectangle. A screen whose clock sits top-left and whose status line sits bottom-right presents the whole frame when both change in one frame, which is no worse than before but leaves the bandwidth gain on the table for exactly the kiosk screens this is for. Is a short fixed list of rectangles (merging the pair with the least wasted area when full) worth the extra code in the painter's hot write paths, or does a screen that cares get the same result by drawing its two regions as two frames? Decide from a measured screen on a Pi, not from the bench: present_with_damage on Wayland and the region copy on KMS are where a list would pay, and neither can be measured headless.

### What has to be true before liminalkit is published as an experimental 0.1?

`open` · `@pixelkit.question.publish-readiness/1`

The outside review (source outside-review-2026-11-03) judged the toolkit worth publishing as an experimental 0.1 once it has a well-defined purpose, a reliable way for someone else to start, and credible evidence it fulfils that purpose. The owner said on 2026-11-03 that it is not ready. Which of the open work records (performance comparison, hardware validation, text fallback, public docs, accessibility validation, UI capabilities) are prerequisites, and which can follow a first release?
